meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin under ₹700 in India, the right serum depends on whether you are treating **active breakouts/clogged pores** or **post-acne marks/excess oil**.

The top dermatologist-backed choices available within this budget include:

---

### 1. For Active Acne, Whiteheads, and Clogged Pores

#### Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:** Approx. ₹545 (30 ml)[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=10%20ml%2030%20ml%20%2B2.%202%20offers.,45%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%20Add%20to%20Cart.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid (BHA), Centella Water.
* **Why it works:** Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, meaning it can deeply penetrate your pores to dissolve trapped sebum, dead skin cells, and acne-causing bacteria. It actively clears up blackheads, whiteheads, and stubborn active pimples.
* **Best for:** Oily, acne-prone skin dealing with frequent, active breakouts.

---

### 2. For Oil Control and Fading Acne Marks (Blemishes)

#### Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum (with Zinc) or The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Serum

* **Price:** Approx. ₹545 – ₹599 (30 ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%20Pore%20Minimizing%20Face%20Serum,Pro%20Retinol%20Complex%2C%2015ml.%20Brightening.%20%E2%82%B9325%E2%82%B927615%25%20Off.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 10% Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), 1% Zinc PCA.
* **Why it works:** Niacinamide regulates sebum production so your face doesn't get overly greasy, while Zinc adds an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial boost.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/news/niacinamide-serums-in-india-10-picks-rated-4-stars#:~:text=Why%20It%20Works%3A%20Niacinamide%20at%2010%25%20regulates,evaluated%20for%20tolerability%20and%20efficacy%20before%20launch.) Crucially, this serum excels at fading dark spots and red marks left behind after acne heals.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/news/niacinamide-serums-in-india-10-picks-rated-4-stars#:~:text=Why%20It%20Works%3A%20Niacinamide%20at%2010%25%20regulates,evaluated%20for%20tolerability%20and%20efficacy%20before%20launch.)
* **Best for:** Skin that is prone to occasional breakouts and stubborn post-acne dark spots.

---

### 3. For Dual Action (Acne + Marks Simultaneously)

#### Deconstruct Salicylic Acid 2% + Niacinamide 3% Serum

* **Price:** Approx. ₹599 – ₹639 (30 ml)[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/anti-acne#:~:text=Hydrocolloid%20Acne%20Pimple%20Patch%20with%202%25%20Salicylic,%28380%20Reviews%29%20Reduces%20pore%20appearance.%20%E2%80%9325%25%20off.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid and 3% Niacinamide.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/anti-acne#:~:text=The%20best%20anti-acne%20products%20contain%20actives%20like,this%20effective%20and%20safe%20for%20daily%20use.)
* **Why it works:** This is a combination serum designed to tackle two issues at once. The salicylic acid clears out the pore congestion causing your pimples, while the niacinamide calms the resulting inflammation and works on fading the mark.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/anti-acne#:~:text=The%20Salicylic%20Acid%20exfoliates%20and%20unclogs%20pores.,and%20bacteria%20from%20skin%20without%20overdrying%20it.)
* **Best for:** A streamlined routine where you want both acne-clearing and mark-reduction benefits in a single bottle.

---

### Quick Buying Guide & Tips:

* **If you have red, angry, active pimples:** Go with **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**.
* **If your skin is mostly clear of active bumps, but you have lots of dark spots/scars and oiliness:** Go with **Minimalist or The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide**.
* **Usage Tip:** Introduce active serums slowly (2 to 3 times a week first) so your skin barrier can adjust, and always wear a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day since acne treatments can make your skin more sensitive to the sun.

Are you dealing mostly with active breakouts or post-acne dark spots right now?
